[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mournwold, Seconded: Weirwater">To commission the Mournwold expansion to the Breadbasket, along with the Keeper's Cottage in Mitwold and to ask for a disbursement of funds.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Mournwold and a [[sinecure]] in Maiden Downs, Mitwold, as per the '''[[Search high and low|Search high and low]]''' wind of fortune. 
* Passed

==Date==
* Spring 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 39 wains of weirwood
* 19 wains of white granite
* 174 crowns in labour costs
* Six months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Expand_Breadbasket_into_Mournwold}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the expansion of the Breadbasket will have the following effects: 
* Grant every farm in the Mournwold an additional 36 rings each season, starting at the Winter Solstice 388YE
* Increases the Marcher ability to support armies by one, once Bregasland is back in Marcher hands
Now complete, the Keeper's Cottage provides the [[Keeper of the Breadbasket]] with an income of 12 crowns a season, starting at the Winter Solstice 388YE
